items.source: An EntityCallback that gets called after an aggregate got deleted. This callback gets only invoked if the method deleting the aggregate received an instance of that aggregate as an argument. Methods deleting entities by id or without any parameter don't invoke this callback.
items.translation: 一个在聚合被删除后调用的EntityCallback。如果删除该聚合的方法接收到了该聚合的实例作为参数，才会调用此回调。通过 ID 删除实体或无参数的删除方法不会触发此回调。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked after an aggregate root was deleted.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在聚合根被删除后被调用。

items.source:
Entity callback method invoked after an aggregate root was deleted. Can return either the same or a modified
instance of the aggregate object.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在聚合根被删除后被调用。可以返回相同的聚合对象实例或修改后的实例。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可以用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
